title: Sensitive Issues Spark Austin Executive Session
summary:
*   A special public meeting was held to formally announce that officials would immediately enter a closed, executive session.
*   This private session was legally authorized to discuss sensitive topics, likely involving personnel, legal matters, or real estate.
*   Any final decisions or votes resulting from the executive session were promised to be made public at a later open meeting.
*   No immediate public policy changes, votes, or discussions occurred during this brief announcement.
